info.title: dotnet-runic
info.description: Generated-command development coordination for Runic Application projects.

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Build the app and coordinate frontend and managed-host watches.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project file or directory. Default: the current directory.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: MSBuild configuration. Default: Debug.

options.name: --host
options.description: desktop or cswebui; defaults to the project selection.

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip NuGet and frozen frontend dependency restore.

options.name: --no-contracts
options.description: Skip Application Bridge contract generation and verification.

options.name: --no-frontend-watch
options.description: Build frontend assets once without starting Vite or Angular watch.

options.name: --no-dotnet-watch
options.description: Run the managed host once without dotnet watch.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the evaluated development plan without starting processes.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check SDK, package-manager, lockfile, package-train, and platform prerequisites.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project file or directory. Default: the current directory.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: MSBuild configuration to inspect. Default: Debug.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project file or directory. Default: the current directory.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: MSBuild configuration. Default: Debug.

options.name: --artifact
options.description: Artifact to render. Default: manifest.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Inspect or apply the bounded CS-WebUI-to-Runic migration.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project file or directory. Default: the current directory.

options.name: --check
options.description: Exit unsuccessfully when migration changes are required.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the exact migration without writing files.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Apply the bounded migration.

commands.name: size
commands.description: Publish and measure a fresh distribution with optional behavior verification.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project file or directory. Default: current directory.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: target runtime, for example linux-x64.

options.name: --host
options.description: desktop or cswebui; defaults to the project selection.

options.name: --profile
options.description: default or minimal (Desktop only). Default: default.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Default: Release.

options.name: --report
options.description: New JSON report path. Default: runic-size.json.

options.name: --no-aot
options.description: Disable NativeAOT; still publish self-contained.

options.name: --verify
options.description: Optional behavior checker; no shell interpolation.

options.name: --verify-argument
options.description:
main executable path are appended automatically.
Publishes into a fresh directory next to the report. Retains logs, hashes,
all files and a ZIP. Culture and diagnostic settings stay project-controlled.
Without a successful checker, behavior is explicitly marked not-run.

commands.name: support
commands.description: Preview, collect, or remove a private local support envelope.

options.name: --mode
options.description: preview, collect, or remove. Default: preview.

options.name: --destination
options.description: Local support-envelope output or removal path.
